title: The Trilingual Triad Framework: Integrating Design, AI, and Domain Knowledge in No-code AI Smart City Course
summary: This paper introduces the "Trilingual Triad" framework, a model that explains how students learn to design with generative artificial intelligence (AI) through the integration of Design, AI, and Domain Knowledge. As generative AI rapidly enters higher education, students often engage with these systems as passive users of generated outputs rather than active creators of AI-enabled knowledge tools. This study investigates how students can transition from using AI as a tool to designing AI as a collaborative teammate. The research examines a graduate course, Creating the Frontier of No-code Smart Cities at the Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD), in which students developed domain-specific custom GPT systems without coding. Using a qualitative multi-case study approach, three projects - the Interview Companion GPT, the Urban Observer GPT, and Buddy Buddy - were analyzed across three dimensions: design, AI architecture, and domain expertise. The findings show that effective human-AI collaboration emerges when these three "languages" are orchestrated together: domain knowledge structures the AI's logic, design mediates human-AI interaction, and AI extends learners' cognitive capacity. The Trilingual Triad framework highlights how building AI systems can serve as a constructionist learning process that strengthens AI literacy, metacognition, and learner agency.

AI.tldr: 提出"三语三元"框架，解释学生如何通过整合设计、AI和领域知识来学习使用生成式AI进行设计，强调从被动使用AI工具到主动设计AI协作伙伴的转变。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI快速进入高等教育，学生通常只是被动使用AI生成的结果，而不是主动创造AI驱动的知识工具。本研究旨在探索学生如何从使用AI工具转变为设计AI协作伙伴，促进更有效的人机协作。
AI.method: 采用定性多案例研究方法，分析新加坡科技设计大学研究生课程"创建无代码智慧城市前沿"中的三个项目：Interview Companion GPT、Urban Observer GPT和Buddy Buddy。从设计、AI架构和领域专业知识三个维度进行分析。
AI.result: 研究发现，当设计、AI和领域知识这三种"语言"协同工作时，有效的人机协作才会出现：领域知识构建AI逻辑，设计调解人机交互，AI扩展学习者的认知能力。构建AI系统可以作为一种建构主义学习过程，增强AI素养、元认知和学习者能动性。
AI.conclusion: 三语三元框架展示了通过整合设计、AI和领域知识，学生可以从被动AI用户转变为主动AI系统设计者。这种建构主义方法不仅培养AI素养，还促进元认知和学习者能动性，为高等教育中生成式AI的教学应用提供了新范式。

title: Enhancing Zero-shot Commonsense Reasoning by Integrating Visual Knowledge via Machine Imagination
summary: Recent advancements in zero-shot commonsense reasoning have empowered Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) to acquire extensive commonsense knowledge without requiring task-specific fine-tuning. Despite this progress, these models frequently suffer from limitations caused by human reporting biases inherent in textual knowledge, leading to understanding discrepancies between machines and humans. To bridge this gap, we introduce an additional modality to enrich the reasoning capabilities of PLMs. We propose Imagine (Machine Imagination-based Reasoning), a novel zero-shot commonsense reasoning framework that supplements textual inputs with visual signals from machine-generated images. Specifically, we enhance PLMs with the ability to imagine by embedding an image generator directly into the reasoning pipeline. To facilitate effective utilization of this imagined visual context, we construct synthetic datasets designed to emulate visual question-answering scenarios. Through comprehensive evaluations on multiple commonsense reasoning benchmarks, we demonstrate that Imagine substantially outperforms existing zero-shot approaches and even surpasses advanced large language models. These results underscore the capability of machine imagination to mitigate reporting bias and significantly enhance the generalization ability of commonsense reasoning models

AI.tldr: 提出Imagine框架，通过机器生成的图像增强预训练语言模型的常识推理能力，在零样本设置下显著提升性能并超越大型语言模型
AI.motivation: 现有零样本常识推理模型受限于文本知识中的人类报告偏差，导致机器与人类理解存在差异，需要引入额外模态来丰富推理能力
AI.method: 提出Imagine框架，将图像生成器嵌入推理流程，为文本输入补充机器生成的视觉信号，并构建合成数据集模拟视觉问答场景以有效利用视觉上下文
AI.result: 在多个常识推理基准测试中，Imagine显著优于现有零样本方法，甚至超越了先进的大型语言模型
AI.conclusion: 机器想象能力能够缓解报告偏差，显著提升常识推理模型的泛化能力，多模态增强是改善零样本常识推理的有效途径

title: BandPO: Bridging Trust Regions and Ratio Clipping via Probability-Aware Bounds for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Proximal constraints are fundamental to the stability of the Large Language Model reinforcement learning. While the canonical clipping mechanism in PPO serves as an efficient surrogate for trust regions, we identify a critical bottleneck: fixed bounds strictly constrain the upward update margin of low-probability actions, disproportionately suppressing high-advantage tail strategies and inducing rapid entropy collapse. To address this, we introduce Band-constrained Policy Optimization (BandPO). BandPO replaces canonical clipping with Band, a unified theoretical operator that projects trust regions defined by f-divergences into dynamic, probability-aware clipping intervals. Theoretical analysis confirms that Band effectively resolves this exploration bottleneck. We formulate this mapping as a convex optimization problem, guaranteeing a globally optimal numerical solution while deriving closed-form solutions for specific divergences. Extensive experiments across diverse models and datasets demonstrate that BandPO consistently outperforms canonical clipping and Clip-Higher, while robustly mitigating entropy collapse.

AI.tldr: BandPO提出动态概率感知的裁剪机制替代PPO固定裁剪，解决低概率动作更新受限问题，防止熵崩溃
AI.motivation: PPO中的固定裁剪机制严格限制了低概率动作的向上更新空间，不成比例地抑制了高优势的尾部策略，导致快速熵崩溃，这是LLM强化学习稳定性的关键瓶颈
AI.method: 提出Band-constrained Policy Optimization (BandPO)，用Band算子替代标准裁剪机制。Band将f-散度定义的信任域投影到动态、概率感知的裁剪区间，通过凸优化问题求解全局最优数值解，并对特定散度推导闭式解
AI.result: 理论分析证实Band有效解决了探索瓶颈。在多样化模型和数据集上的实验表明，BandPO持续优于标准裁剪和Clip-Higher方法，同时稳健地缓解了熵崩溃
AI.conclusion: BandPO通过动态概率感知的裁剪机制解决了PPO固定裁剪的关键限制，为LLM强化学习提供了更稳定高效的优化框架，有效平衡探索与利用

title: $\nabla$-Reasoner: LLM Reasoning via Test-Time Gradient Descent in Latent Space
summary:
Scaling inference-time compute for Large Language Models (LLMs) has unlocked unprecedented reasoning capabilities. However, existing inference-time scaling methods typically rely on inefficient and suboptimal discrete search algorithms or trial-and-error prompting to improve the online policy. In this paper, we propose $
abla$-Reasoner, an iterative generation framework that integrates differentiable optimization over token logits into the decoding loop to refine the policy on the fly. Our core component, Differentiable Textual Optimization (DTO), leverages gradient signals from both the LLM's likelihood and a reward model to refine textual representations. $
abla$-Reasoner further incorporates rejection sampling and acceleration design to robustify and speed up decoding. Theoretically, we show that performing inference-time gradient descent in the sample space to maximize reward is dual to aligning an LLM policy via KL-regularized reinforcement learning. Empirically, $
abla$-Reasoner achieves over 20% accuracy improvement on a challenging mathematical reasoning benchmark, while reducing number of model calls by approximately 10-40% compared to strong baselines. Overall, our work introduces a paradigm shift from zeroth-order search to first-order optimization at test time, offering a cost-effective path to amplify LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: ∇-Reasoner：一种在解码循环中集成可微分优化的迭代生成框架，通过梯度信号优化token logits来实时改进推理策略，相比传统离散搜索方法显著提升推理性能并减少模型调用次数。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时扩展方法通常依赖低效的离散搜索算法或试错提示来改进在线策略，需要更高效、优化的推理时计算方法来提升大语言模型的推理能力。
AI.method: 提出∇-Reasoner框架，核心是可微分文本优化（DTO），利用LLM似然和奖励模型的梯度信号优化文本表示；结合拒绝采样和加速设计来增强鲁棒性和解码速度；理论证明推理时在样本空间进行梯度下降最大化奖励与通过KL正则化强化学习对齐LLM策略是对偶的。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的数学推理基准上实现超过20%的准确率提升；相比强基线减少约10-40%的模型调用次数；从零阶搜索转向一阶优化，为增强LLM推理提供了成本效益高的路径。
AI.conclusion: ∇-Reasoner代表了从测试时零阶搜索到一阶优化的范式转变，通过可微分优化在解码循环中实时改进策略，显著提升推理性能同时降低计算成本，为大语言模型推理能力扩展提供了新方向。

title: Bidirectional Curriculum Generation: A Multi-Agent Framework for Data-Efficient Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Enhancing mathematical reasoning in Large Language Models typically demands massive datasets, yet data efficiency remains a critical bottleneck. While Curriculum Learning attempts to structure this process, standard unidirectional approaches (simple-to-complex) suffer from inefficient sample utilization: they blindly escalate complexity even when foundational gaps persist, leading to wasted computation on unsolvable problems. To maximize the instructional value of every training sample, we introduce a novel Bidirectional Curriculum Generation framework. Unlike rigid trajectories, our multi-agent ecosystem mimics adaptive pedagogy to establish a closed feedback loop. It dynamically generates data by either complicating problems to challenge the model or, crucially, simplying them to repair specific reasoning failures. This mechanism ensures that the model consumes only the most effective data at any given stage. Grounded in the Optimal Pacing Theorem, our approach optimizes the learning trajectory, significantly outperforming baselines while achieving superior reasoning performance with substantially fewer instruction samples.

AI.tldr: 提出双向课程生成框架，通过多智能体生态系统动态生成数据，既能增加问题复杂度挑战模型，也能简化问题修复推理缺陷，显著提高数据效率
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的数学推理能力提升通常需要海量数据集，但数据效率是关键瓶颈。传统单向课程学习（简单到复杂）存在样本利用效率低的问题，盲目增加复杂度而忽视基础缺陷，导致计算资源浪费在无法解决的问题上
AI.method: 提出双向课程生成框架，采用多智能体生态系统模拟自适应教学法，建立闭环反馈循环。动态生成数据：既能增加问题复杂度挑战模型，也能简化问题修复特定推理缺陷。基于最优节奏定理优化学习轨迹
AI.result: 显著优于基线方法，在显著减少指令样本的情况下实现更优的推理性能
AI.conclusion: 双向课程生成框架通过确保模型在任何阶段只消费最有效的数据，最大化每个训练样本的教学价值，解决了数据效率瓶颈问题

title: Uncertainty-aware Blood Glucose Prediction from Continuous Glucose Monitoring Data
summary: In this work, we investigate uncertainty-aware neural network models for blood glucose prediction and adverse glycemic event identification in Type 1 diabetes. We consider three families of sequence models based on LSTM, GRU, and Transformer architectures, with uncertainty quantification enabled by either Monte Carlo dropout or through evidential output layers compatible with Deep Evidential Regression. Using the HUPA-UCM diabetes dataset for validation, we find that Transformer-based models equipped with evidential output heads provide the most effective uncertainty-aware framework, achieving consistently higher predictive accuracies and better-calibrated uncertainty estimates whose magnitudes significantly correlate with prediction errors. We further evaluate the clinical risk of each model using the recently proposed Diabetes Technology Society error grid, with risk categories defined by international expert consensus. Our results demonstrate the value of integrating principled uncertainty quantification into real-time machine-learning-based blood glucose prediction systems.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了三种基于LSTM、GRU和Transformer的序列模型，通过蒙特卡洛dropout或证据输出层实现不确定性量化，用于1型糖尿病的血糖预测和不良血糖事件识别。Transformer结合证据输出头在预测准确性和不确定性校准方面表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 将不确定性量化整合到实时机器学习血糖预测系统中，以提高预测可靠性并识别不良血糖事件，这对于1型糖尿病管理至关重要。
AI.method: 使用基于LSTM、GRU和Transformer的三种序列模型家族，通过蒙特卡洛dropout或深度证据回归兼容的证据输出层实现不确定性量化。使用HUPA-UCM糖尿病数据集进行验证，并通过糖尿病技术学会误差网格评估临床风险。
AI.result: 配备证据输出头的Transformer模型提供了最有效的不确定性感知框架，实现了持续更高的预测准确性和更好校准的不确定性估计，其幅度与预测误差显著相关。
AI.conclusion: 将原则性不确定性量化整合到实时机器学习血糖预测系统中具有重要价值，Transformer结合证据输出层在预测性能和不确定性校准方面表现最优。

title: MedCoRAG: Interpretable Hepatology Diagnosis via Hybrid Evidence Retrieval and Multispecialty Consensus
summary: Diagnosing hepatic diseases accurately and interpretably is critical, yet it remains challenging in real-world clinical settings. Existing AI approaches for clinical diagnosis often lack transparency, structured reasoning, and deployability. Recent efforts have leveraged large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent collaboration. However, these approaches typically retrieve evidence from a single source and fail to support iterative, role-specialized deliberation grounded in structured clinical data. To address this, we propose MedCoRAG (i.e., Medical Collaborative RAG), an end-to-end framework that generates diagnostic hypotheses from standardized abnormal findings and constructs a patient-specific evidence package by jointly retrieving and pruning UMLS knowledge graph paths and clinical guidelines. It then performs Multi-Agent Collaborative Reasoning: a Router Agent dynamically dispatches Specialist Agents based on case complexity; these agents iteratively reason over the evidence and trigger targeted re-retrievals when needed, while a Generalist Agent synthesizes all deliberations into a traceable consensus diagnosis that emulates multidisciplinary consultation. Experimental results on hepatic disease cases from MIMIC-IV show that MedCoRAG outperforms existing methods and closed-source models in both diagnostic performance and reasoning interpretability.

AI.tldr: MedCoRAG是一个用于肝病诊断的端到端框架，通过多智能体协作检索增强生成，结合知识图谱和临床指南，实现可解释的诊断推理。
AI.motivation: 现有AI临床诊断方法缺乏透明度、结构化推理和可部署性，且通常从单一来源检索证据，无法支持基于结构化临床数据的迭代式、角色专业化审议。
AI.method: 提出MedCoRAG框架：1)从标准化异常发现生成诊断假设；2)联合检索和剪枝UMLS知识图谱路径和临床指南构建患者特异性证据包；3)多智能体协作推理：路由器智能体根据病例复杂度动态调度专科智能体进行迭代推理和针对性重检索，通用智能体将所有审议综合为可追溯的共识诊断。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV肝病病例上的实验结果表明，MedCoRAG在诊断性能和推理可解释性方面均优于现有方法和闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: MedCoRAG通过多智能体协作RAG框架，实现了基于结构化临床数据的可解释肝病诊断，模拟了多学科会诊过程，在真实临床环境中具有应用潜力。

title: WaterSIC: information-theoretically (near) optimal linear layer quantization
summary: This paper considers the problem of converting a given dense linear layer to low precision. The tradeoff between compressed length and output discrepancy is analyzed information theoretically (IT). It is shown that a popular GPTQ algorithm may have an arbitrarily large gap to the IT limit. To alleviate this problem, a novel algorithm, termed ''WaterSIC'', is proposed and is shown to be within a rate gap of 0.255 bits to the IT limit, uniformly over all possible covariance matrices of input activations. The key innovation of WaterSIC's is to allocate different quantization rates to different columns (in-features) of the weight matrix, mimicking the classical IT solution known as ''waterfilling''. Applying WaterSIC to the Llama and Qwen family of LLMs establishes new state-of-the-art performance for all quantization rates from 1 to 4 bits.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为WaterSIC的新型量化算法，用于将密集线性层转换为低精度表示，通过信息论分析压缩长度与输出误差之间的权衡，并在Llama和Qwen系列LLMs上实现了1-4比特量化率的最新性能。
AI.motivation: 现有GPTQ算法在将密集线性层转换为低精度时，其压缩性能与信息论极限可能存在任意大的差距，需要开发更接近理论极限的量化方法。
AI.method: 提出WaterSIC算法，采用类似信息论中"注水"策略的方法，为权重矩阵的不同列（输入特征）分配不同的量化率，以更有效地利用比特资源。
AI.result: WaterSIC算法在信息论极限的0.255比特速率差距内，均匀适用于所有可能的输入激活协方差矩阵。在Llama和Qwen系列LLMs上，1-4比特量化率均达到最新技术水平。
AI.conclusion: WaterSIC算法通过基于信息论的列级量化率分配策略，显著改进了现有量化方法的性能，为大型语言模型的高效低精度部署提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Mixture of Universal Experts: Scaling Virtual Width via Depth-Width Transformation
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) decouples model capacity from per-token computation, yet their scalability remains limited by the physical dimensions of depth and width. To overcome this, we propose Mixture of Universal Experts (MOUE),a MoE generalization introducing a novel scaling dimension: Virtual Width. In general, MoUE aims to reuse a universal layer-agnostic expert pool across layers, converting depth into virtual width under a fixed per-token activation budget. However, two challenges remain: a routing path explosion from recursive expert reuse, and a mismatch between the exposure induced by reuse and the conventional load-balancing objectives. We address these with three core components: a Staggered Rotational Topology for structured expert sharing, a Universal Expert Load Balance for depth-aware exposure correction, and a Universal Router with lightweight trajectory state for coherent multi-step routing. Empirically, MoUE consistently outperforms matched MoE baselines by up to 1.3% across scaling regimes, enables progressive conversion of existing MoE checkpoints with up to 4.2% gains, and reveals a new scaling dimension for MoE architectures.

AI.tldr: MOUE引入虚拟宽度作为MoE的新扩展维度，通过跨层复用通用专家池，在固定激活预算下将深度转换为虚拟宽度，解决了路由路径爆炸和负载均衡不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 传统MoE架构的扩展受限于物理深度和宽度维度，需要新的扩展维度来提升模型容量而不增加每token计算成本。
AI.method: 提出MOUE框架，包含三个核心组件：交错旋转拓扑实现结构化专家共享，通用专家负载均衡进行深度感知的暴露校正，以及带轻量轨迹状态的通用路由器实现连贯的多步路由。
AI.result: MOUE在多个扩展场景下比匹配的MoE基线性能提升高达1.3%，能够渐进式转换现有MoE检查点并获得高达4.2%的增益，揭示了MoE架构的新扩展维度。
AI.conclusion: MOUE通过引入虚拟宽度维度成功扩展了MoE架构，解决了专家复用带来的路由和负载均衡挑战，为MoE模型提供了新的扩展路径。

title: X-RAY: Mapping LLM Reasoning Capability via Formalized and Calibrated Probes
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve promising performance, yet their ability to reason remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations largely emphasize task-level accuracy, often conflating pattern matching with reasoning capability. We present X-RAY, an explainable reasoning analysis system that maps the LLM reasoning capability using calibrated, formally verified probes. We model reasoning capability as a function of extractable \textit{structure}, operationalized through formal properties such as constraint interaction, reasoning depth, and solution-space geometry. X-Ray generates probes via formal tools with controlled structural variations, enabling precise isolation of incremental structural information through formal calibration and verification. We evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs on problems ranging from junior-level to advanced in mathematics, physics, and chemistry. Our analysis reveals a systematic asymmetry in LLM reasoning: models are relatively robust to constraint refinement, where additional conditions shrink an existing solution space, but degrade sharply under solution-space restructuring, where modifications alter the underlying structural form of the solution manifold. Moreover, calibrated formal probes differentiate models that appear indistinguishable on standard benchmarks and reveal failure modes that are structurally interpretable rather than opaque. Beyond evaluation, our framework is contamination-free and supports the training and testing of reasoning models.

AI.tldr: X-RAY是一个可解释的推理分析系统，通过形式化校准的探针来评估大语言模型的推理能力，揭示模型在约束细化与解空间重构上的不对称表现。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法主要关注任务级准确率，往往混淆模式匹配与真实推理能力，缺乏对LLM推理能力的深入理解。需要一种能够精确分析推理能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出X-RAY系统，将推理能力建模为可提取结构的功能，通过约束交互、推理深度和解空间几何等形式属性进行操作化。使用形式化工具生成具有受控结构变化的探针，通过形式校准和验证精确隔离增量结构信息。
AI.result: 评估显示LLM推理存在系统性不对称：模型对约束细化相对稳健（附加条件缩小现有解空间），但在解空间重构下性能急剧下降（修改改变解流形的基本结构形式）。校准的形式探针能够区分在标准基准上表现相似的模型，并揭示结构可解释而非不透明的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: X-RAY提供了一个无污染、可解释的推理分析框架，不仅能评估LLM推理能力，还能支持推理模型的训练和测试，超越了传统基于准确率的评估方法。

title: STRUCTUREDAGENT: Planning with AND/OR Trees for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agentic systems for sequential decision-making. Such agents must perceive their environment, reason across multiple time steps, and take actions that optimize long-term objectives. However, existing web agents struggle on complex, long-horizon tasks due to limited in-context memory for tracking history, weak planning abilities, and greedy behaviors that lead to premature termination. To address these challenges, we propose STRUCTUREDAGENT, a hierarchical planning framework with two core components: (1) an online hierarchical planner that uses dynamic AND/OR trees for efficient search and (2) a structured memory module that tracks and maintains candidate solutions to improve constraint satisfaction in information-seeking tasks. The framework also produces interpretable hierarchical plans, enabling easier debugging and facilitating human intervention when needed. Our results on WebVoyager, WebArena, and custom shopping benchmarks show that STRUCTUREDAGENT improves performance on long-horizon web-browsing tasks compared to standard LLM-based agents.

AI.tldr: STRUCTUREDAGENT：一种用于长视野网页浏览任务的分层规划框架，通过动态AND/OR树和结构化记忆模块解决现有智能体在复杂任务中的局限性
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的网页智能体在复杂、长视野任务中存在三个主要问题：上下文记忆有限导致历史追踪困难、规划能力弱、贪婪行为导致过早终止。这些限制使得智能体难以完成需要多步骤推理和长期目标优化的网页浏览任务。
AI.method: 提出STRUCTUREDAGENT框架，包含两个核心组件：1）在线分层规划器，使用动态AND/OR树进行高效搜索；2）结构化记忆模块，跟踪和维护候选解决方案以改善信息搜索任务中的约束满足。该框架还生成可解释的分层计划，便于调试和必要时的人工干预。
AI.result: 在WebVoyager、WebArena和自定义购物基准测试中，STRUCTUREDAGENT相比标准基于LLM的智能体，在长视野网页浏览任务上表现出更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: STRUCTUREDAGENT通过分层规划和结构化记忆有效解决了现有网页智能体在复杂长视野任务中的局限性，提高了任务完成能力，同时提供了更好的可解释性和人工干预可能性。

title: WebChain: A Large-Scale Human-Annotated Dataset of Real-World Web Interaction Traces
summary: We introduce WebChain, the largest open-source dataset of human-annotated trajectories on real-world websites, designed to accelerate reproducible research in web agents. It contains 31,725 trajectories and 318k steps, featuring a core Triple Alignment of visual, structural, and action data to provide rich, multi-modal supervision. The data is collected via a scalable pipeline that ensures coverage of complex, high-value tasks often missed by synthetic methods. Leveraging this dataset, we propose a Dual Mid-Training recipe that decouples spatial grounding from planning, achieving state-of-the-art performance on our proposed WebChainBench and other public GUI benchmarks. Our work provides the data and insights necessary to build and rigorously evaluate the next generation of scalable web agents.

AI.tldr: WebChain是一个包含31,725条轨迹、318k步骤的开源网页交互数据集，采用视觉、结构和动作三重对齐，支持多模态监督。基于此数据集提出的Dual Mid-Training方法在WebChainBench等基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 当前网页智能体研究缺乏大规模、高质量的真实网页交互数据集，现有合成方法难以覆盖复杂高价值任务，限制了网页智能体的可复现研究和性能评估。
AI.method: 1) 构建WebChain数据集：通过可扩展的采集流程收集真实网页上的人类标注轨迹，实现视觉、结构、动作三重对齐；2) 提出Dual Mid-Training训练方法：将空间定位与任务规划解耦，分别进行中间训练。
AI.result: WebChain是目前最大的开源网页交互数据集，包含31,725条轨迹和318k步骤。基于该数据集训练的模型在提出的WebChainBench和其他公开GUI基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: WebChain数据集和Dual Mid-Training方法为构建和严格评估下一代可扩展网页智能体提供了必要的数据和洞见，推动了网页智能体研究的可复现性发展。

title: Asymptotic Behavior of Multi--Task Learning: Implicit Regularization and Double Descent Effects
summary: Multi--task learning seeks to improve the generalization error by leveraging the common information shared by multiple related tasks. One challenge in multi--task learning is identifying formulations capable of uncovering the common information shared between different but related tasks. This paper provides a precise asymptotic analysis of a popular multi--task formulation associated with misspecified perceptron learning models. The main contribution of this paper is to precisely determine the reasons behind the benefits gained from combining multiple related tasks. Specifically, we show that combining multiple tasks is asymptotically equivalent to a traditional formulation with additional regularization terms that help improve the generalization performance. Another contribution is to empirically study the impact of combining tasks on the generalization error. In particular, we empirically show that the combination of multiple tasks postpones the double descent phenomenon and can mitigate it asymptotically.

AI.tldr: 该论文对多任务学习中的感知器误设模型进行精确渐近分析，揭示了多任务组合如何通过隐式正则化改善泛化性能并缓解双下降现象。
AI.motivation: 多任务学习通过共享多个相关任务的共同信息来改善泛化误差，但挑战在于找到能够有效揭示任务间共同信息的数学表述。本文旨在精确分析多任务学习为何能带来性能提升，特别是理解组合多个任务对泛化误差的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用精确渐近分析方法，研究误设感知器学习模型的多任务学习表述。通过理论分析证明多任务组合等价于传统单任务学习加上额外的正则化项，并进行实证研究验证理论发现。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，组合多个任务在渐近意义上等价于传统表述加上额外的正则化项，这些正则化项有助于改善泛化性能。实证研究发现，多任务组合能够推迟双下降现象的发生，并在渐近情况下缓解该现象。
AI.conclusion: 多任务学习通过隐式正则化机制改善泛化性能，组合多个相关任务不仅等价于添加正则化项，还能有效缓解深度学习中的双下降现象，为多任务学习的理论理解和实际应用提供了重要见解。

title: Ailed: A Psyche-Driven Chess Engine with Dynamic Emotional Modulation
comment: 27 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Open source: https://github.com/chrnx-dev/ailed-chess
summary:
Chess engines passed human strength years ago, but they still don't play like humans. A grandmaster under clock pressure blunders in ways a club player on a hot streak never would. Conventional engines capture none of this.
  This paper proposes a personality x psyche decomposition to produce behavioral variability in chess play, drawing on patterns observed in human games. Personality is static -- a preset that pins down the engine's character. Psyche is dynamic -- a bounded scalar ψ_t \in [-100, +100], recomputed from five positional factors after every move. These two components feed into an audio-inspired signal chain (noise gate, compressor/expander, five-band equalizer, saturation limiter) that reshapes move probability distributions on the fly. The chain doesn't care what engine sits behind it: any system that outputs move probabilities will do. It needs no search and carries no state beyond ψ_t.
  I test the framework across 12,414 games against Maia2-1100, feeding it two probability sources that differ by ~2,800x in training data. Both show the same monotonic gradient in top-move agreement (~20-25 pp spread from stress to overconfidence), which tells us the behavioral variation comes from the signal chain, not from the model underneath. When the psyche runs overconfident, the chain mostly gets out of the way (66% agreement with vanilla Maia2). Under stress, the competitive score falls from 50.8% to 30.1%. The patterns are reminiscent of tilt and overconfidence as described in human play, but I should be upfront: this study includes no human-subject validation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将国际象棋引擎行为分解为静态人格和动态心理状态的框架，通过音频信号链处理移动概率分布，模拟人类棋手的心理波动对决策的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统国际象棋引擎虽然棋力超越人类，但缺乏人类棋手特有的心理波动和行为变化。人类棋手在时间压力下会犯下业余棋手不会犯的错误，这种心理因素导致的决策变化是传统引擎无法模拟的。
AI.method: 提出人格-心理分解框架：人格是静态预设，定义引擎的基本特征；心理状态ψ_t是动态标量，每步棋后根据五个位置因素重新计算。两者输入音频信号链（噪声门、压缩器/扩展器、五段均衡器、饱和限制器），实时重塑移动概率分布。该框架不依赖特定引擎，任何输出移动概率的系统都适用，无需搜索且仅保持ψ_t状态。
AI.result: 在12,414局对Maia2-1100的测试中，使用两种训练数据相差约2800倍的概率源，均显示相同单调梯度：从压力到过度自信，顶级移动一致性变化约20-25个百分点。心理状态过度自信时，信号链基本不干预（与原始Maia2一致性66%）；压力状态下，竞争得分从50.8%降至30.1%。行为模式类似人类棋手的"倾斜"和过度自信现象。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功将行为变化与底层模型分离，信号链独立产生心理状态驱动的决策变化。虽然模式类似人类心理现象，但研究缺乏人类主体验证。该方法为国际象棋引擎引入人类心理维度提供了新途径。

title: Reward-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: RL agents are typically trained under a single, fixed reward function, which makes them brittle to reward misspecification and limits their ability to adapt to changing task preferences. We introduce Reward-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning (RCRL), a framework that trains a single agent to optimize a family of reward specifications while collecting experience under only one nominal objective. RCRL conditions the agent on reward parameterizations and learns multiple reward objectives from a shared replay data entirely off-policy, enabling a single policy to represent reward-specific behaviors. Across single-task, multi-task, and vision-based benchmarks, we show that RCRL not only improves performance under the nominal reward parameterization, but also enables efficient adaptation to new parameterizations. Our results demonstrate that RCRL provides a scalable mechanism for learning robust, steerable policies without sacrificing the simplicity of single-task training.

AI.tldr: RCRL框架训练单一智能体优化一族奖励函数，仅需在单一名义目标下收集经验，通过奖励参数化条件化智能体，实现从共享回放数据中离策略学习多个奖励目标。
AI.motivation: 传统RL智能体在单一固定奖励函数下训练，对奖励误设敏感且难以适应任务偏好变化，需要更鲁棒、可适应的策略学习框架。
AI.method: 提出奖励条件化强化学习(RCRL)，通过奖励参数化条件化智能体，使其能够从共享回放数据中离策略学习多个奖励目标，实现单一策略表示奖励特定行为。
AI.result: 在单任务、多任务和基于视觉的基准测试中，RCRL不仅提升了名义奖励参数化下的性能，还能高效适应新参数化，展示出鲁棒性和可引导性。
AI.conclusion: RCRL为学习鲁棒、可引导策略提供了可扩展机制，无需牺牲单任务训练的简单性，解决了奖励误设和任务偏好变化的适应性问题。

title: PACE: A Personalized Adaptive Curriculum Engine for 9-1-1 Call-taker Training
summary: 9-1-1 call-taking training requires mastery of over a thousand interdependent skills, covering diverse incident types and protocol-specific nuances. A nationwide labor shortage is already straining training capacity, but effective instruction still demands that trainers tailor objectives to each trainee's evolving competencies. This personalization burden is one that current practice cannot scale. Partnering with Metro Nashville Department of Emergency Communications (MNDEC), we propose PACE (Personalized Adaptive Curriculum Engine), a co-pilot system that augments trainer decision-making by (1) maintaining probabilistic beliefs over trainee skill states, (2) modeling individual learning and forgetting dynamics, and (3) recommending training scenarios that balance acquisition of new competencies with retention of existing ones. PACE propagates evidence over a structured skill graph to accelerate diagnostic coverage and applies contextual bandits to select scenarios that target gaps the trainee is prepared to address. Empirical results show that PACE achieves 19.50% faster time-to-competence and 10.95% higher terminal mastery compared to state-of-the-art frameworks. Co-pilot studies with practicing training officers further demonstrate a 95.45% alignment rate between PACE's and experts' pedagogical judgments on real-world cases. Under estimation, PACE cuts turnaround time to merely 34 seconds from 11.58 minutes, up to 95.08% reduction.

AI.tldr: PACE系统通过个性化自适应课程引擎，利用概率技能状态建模和情境多臂老虎机算法，为911调度员培训提供个性化场景推荐，显著提升培训效率。
AI.motivation: 911调度员培训需要掌握上千种相互依赖的技能，覆盖多种事件类型和协议细节。全国性的劳动力短缺已经使培训能力紧张，而有效的教学仍要求培训师根据学员不断发展的能力定制目标。这种个性化负担是目前实践无法扩展的。
AI.method: PACE系统通过三个核心功能增强培训师决策：(1)维护学员技能状态的概率信念，(2)建模个体学习和遗忘动态，(3)推荐平衡新能力获取与现有能力保持的训练场景。系统在结构化技能图上传播证据以加速诊断覆盖，并应用情境多臂老虎机算法选择针对学员准备填补的差距的场景。
AI.result: 实证结果显示，PACE相比最先进框架实现了19.50%更快的达到能力时间（time-to-competence）和10.95%更高的最终掌握度。与在职培训官员的协同研究进一步显示，在真实案例中，PACE与专家的教学判断有95.45%的一致性。在评估方面，PACE将周转时间从11.58分钟减少到仅34秒，减少了高达95.08%。
AI.conclusion: PACE系统通过个性化自适应课程引擎有效解决了911调度员培训中的个性化扩展问题，显著提升了培训效率和效果，为紧急通信培训提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Synchronization-based clustering on the unit hypersphere
summary: Clustering on the unit hypersphere is a fundamental problem in various fields, with applications ranging from gene expression analysis to text and image classification. Traditional clustering methods are not always suitable for unit sphere data, as they do not account for the geometric structure of the sphere. We introduce a novel algorithm for clustering data represented as points on the unit sphere $\mathbf{S}^{d-1}$. Our method is based on the $d$-dimensional generalized Kuramoto model. The effectiveness of the introduced method is demonstrated on synthetic and real-world datasets. Results are compared with some of the traditional clustering methods, showing that our method achieves similar or better results in terms of clustering accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出基于广义Kuramoto模型的新聚类算法，用于单位超球面上的数据聚类，相比传统方法能更好地处理球面几何结构
AI.motivation: 单位超球面聚类在基因表达分析、文本和图像分类等领域有重要应用，但传统聚类方法未能充分考虑球面的几何结构，需要专门针对球面数据设计的聚类算法
AI.method: 基于d维广义Kuramoto模型，将数据点视为单位球面上的点，利用该模型的同步特性实现聚类
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上验证了方法的有效性，与传统聚类方法相比，取得了相似或更好的聚类准确率
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于广义Kuramoto模型的算法是单位超球面数据聚类的有效方法，能够处理球面几何结构，在多个应用领域具有实用价值

title: Legal interpretation and AI: from expert systems to argumentation and LLMs
summary: AI and Law research has encountered legal interpretation in different ways, in the context of its evolving approaches and methodologies. Research on expert system has focused on legal knowledge engineering, with the goal of ensuring that human-generated interpretations can be precisely transferred into knowledge-bases, to be consistently applied. Research on argumentation has aimed at representing the structure of interpretive arguments, as well as their dialectical interactions, to assess of the acceptability of interpretive claims within argumentation frameworks. Research on machine learning has focused on the automated generation of interpretive suggestions and arguments, through general and specialised language models, now being increasingly deployed in legal practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了AI与法律研究中法律解释的三种主要方法：专家系统、论证理论和机器学习，分析了各自在捕捉、表示和应用法律解释方面的不同路径。
AI.motivation: 随着AI与法律研究方法和范式的演变，法律解释问题以不同方式被处理。作者旨在系统梳理AI在法律解释领域的研究路径，分析不同方法如何应对法律解释的复杂性，并理解这些方法如何随着AI技术的发展而演进。
AI.method: 论文采用文献综述和分类分析方法，将AI与法律研究中的法律解释方法分为三类：1)专家系统方法：专注于法律知识工程，将人类解释精确编码到知识库中；2)论证方法：关注解释性论证的结构表示及其辩证互动，在论证框架内评估解释性主张的可接受性；3)机器学习方法：通过通用和专门的语言模型自动生成解释性建议和论证。
AI.result: 分析揭示了三种主要研究路径：专家系统方法强调知识表示和一致性应用；论证方法关注论证结构和辩证评估；机器学习方法侧重于自动生成解释性内容。这些方法反映了AI与法律研究从基于规则的系统到基于论证的框架，再到数据驱动模型的演进轨迹。
AI.conclusion: AI与法律研究通过不同范式处理法律解释问题，每种方法都有其优势和局限性。专家系统确保精确性但缺乏灵活性，论证方法捕捉辩证过程但计算复杂，机器学习方法能自动生成但可解释性有限。当前趋势显示机器学习方法（特别是语言模型）在法律实践中日益普及，但需要结合其他方法的优势来全面应对法律解释的挑战。

title: Aura: Universal Multi-dimensional Exogenous Integration for Aviation Time Series
summary: Time series forecasting has witnessed an increasing demand across diverse industrial applications, where accurate predictions are pivotal for informed decision-making. Beyond numerical time series data, reliable forecasting in practical scenarios requires integrating diverse exogenous factors. Such exogenous information is often multi-dimensional or even multimodal, introducing heterogeneous interactions that unimodal time series models struggle to capture. In this paper, we delve into an aviation maintenance scenario and identify three distinct types of exogenous factors that influence temporal dynamics through distinct interaction modes. Based on this empirical insight, we propose Aura, a universal framework that explicitly organizes and encodes heterogeneous external information according to its interaction mode with the target time series. Specifically, Aura utilizes a tailored tripartite encoding mechanism to embed heterogeneous features into well-established time series models, ensuring seamless integration of non-sequential context. Extensive experiments on a large-scale, three-year industrial dataset from China Southern Airlines, covering the Boeing 777 and Airbus A320 fleets, demonstrate that Aura consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across all baselines and exhibits superior adaptability. Our findings highlight Aura's potential as a general-purpose enhancement for aviation safety and reliability.

AI.tldr: Aura是一个通用框架，通过三部分编码机制将异质外部信息整合到时间序列模型中，在航空维护场景中显著提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 实际应用中时间序列预测需要整合多维甚至多模态的外生因素，这些异质信息以不同交互模式影响时间动态，而单模态时间序列模型难以有效捕捉这些异质交互。
AI.method: 提出Aura框架，根据外生因素与目标时间序列的交互模式，显式组织和编码异质外部信息。采用定制的三部分编码机制，将异质特征嵌入到成熟的时间序列模型中，确保非序列上下文的无缝整合。
AI.result: 在中国南方航空公司涵盖波音777和空客A320机队的大规模三年工业数据集上进行广泛实验，Aura在所有基线方法中一致达到最先进性能，并展现出卓越的适应性。
AI.conclusion: Aura作为通用增强框架，在航空安全和可靠性方面具有重要潜力，能够有效整合异质外生信息以提升时间序列预测准确性。

title: Axiomatic On-Manifold Shapley via Optimal Generative Flows
summary: Shapley-based attribution is critical for post-hoc XAI but suffers from off-manifold artifacts due to heuristic baselines. While generative methods attempt to address this, they often introduce geometric inefficiency and discretization drift. We propose a formal theory of on-manifold Aumann-Shapley attributions driven by optimal generative flows. We prove a representation theorem establishing the gradient line integral as the unique functional satisfying efficiency and geometric axioms, notably reparameterization invariance. To resolve path ambiguity, we select the kinetic-energy-minimizing Wasserstein-2 geodesic transporting a prior to the data distribution. This yields a canonical attribution family that recovers classical Shapley for additive models and admits provable stability bounds against flow approximation errors. By reframing baseline selection as a variational problem, our method experimentally outperforms baselines, achieving strict manifold adherence via vanishing Flow Consistency Error and superior semantic alignment characterized by Structure-Aware Total Variation. Our code is on https://github.com/cenweizhang/OTFlowSHAP.

AI.tldr: 提出基于最优生成流的流形上Aumann-Shapley归因理论，通过Wasserstein-2测地线解决路径模糊问题，实现严格流形对齐和语义一致性
AI.motivation: 传统Shapley归因方法因启发式基线选择产生流形外伪影，现有生成方法存在几何低效和离散化漂移问题，需要建立严格的流形上归因理论
AI.method: 提出基于最优生成流的Aumann-Shapley归因形式理论，证明梯度线积分是满足效率和几何公理（特别是重参数化不变性）的唯一泛函；通过选择将先验分布传输到数据分布的动能最小化Wasserstein-2测地线解决路径模糊问题
AI.result: 建立了规范归因族，在加性模型中恢复经典Shapley值，提供对流动近似误差的可证明稳定性边界；实验表明方法优于基线，通过零流一致性误差实现严格流形对齐，在结构感知总变差指标上表现优异
AI.conclusion: 通过将基线选择重构为变分问题，提出了基于最优传输流的流形上Aumann-Shapley归因理论，解决了传统方法的流形外伪影问题，实现了严格流形对齐和语义一致性

title: Dissociating Direct Access from Inference in AI Introspection
summary: Introspection is a foundational cognitive ability, but its mechanism is not well understood. Recent work has shown that AI models can introspect. We study their mechanism of introspection, first extensively replicating Lindsey et al. (2025)'s thought injection detection paradigm in large open-source models. We show that these models detect injected representations via two separable mechanisms: (i) probability-matching (inferring from perceived anomaly of the prompt) and (ii) direct access to internal states. The direct access mechanism is content-agnostic: models detect that an anomaly occurred but cannot reliably identify its semantic content. The two model classes we study confabulate injected concepts that are high-frequency and concrete (e.g., "apple'"); for them correct concept guesses typically require significantly more tokens. This content-agnostic introspective mechanism is consistent with leading theories in philosophy and psychology.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了AI模型的内省机制，发现它们通过概率匹配和直接访问内部状态两种可分离机制检测注入表示，其中直接访问机制是内容无关的
AI.motivation: 内省是基础认知能力但其机制尚不明确，近期研究表明AI模型能够内省，需要研究其内省机制以理解AI的认知过程
AI.method: 首先广泛复现Lindsey等人(2025)的思想注入检测范式，在大型开源模型中进行研究，分析模型检测注入表示的机制
AI.result: 模型通过两种可分离机制检测注入表示：(1)概率匹配(从感知到的提示异常推断)；(2)直接访问内部状态。直接访问机制是内容无关的：模型能检测到异常发生但无法可靠识别其语义内容。研究的模型类别会虚构高频具体概念，正确概念猜测通常需要显著更多标记
AI.conclusion: 这种内容无关的内省机制与哲学和心理学中的主要理论一致，为理解AI内省机制提供了实证基础

title: Decoupling Task and Behavior: A Two-Stage Reward Curriculum in Reinforcement Learning for Robotics
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning is a promising tool for robotic control, yet practical application is often hindered by the difficulty of designing effective reward functions. Real-world tasks typically require optimizing multiple objectives simultaneously, necessitating precise tuning of their weights to learn a policy with the desired characteristics. To address this, we propose a two-stage reward curriculum where we decouple task-specific objectives from behavioral terms. In our method, we first train the agent on a simplified task-only reward function to ensure effective exploration before introducing the full reward that includes auxiliary behavior-related terms such as energy efficiency. Further, we analyze various transition strategies and demonstrate that reusing samples between phases is critical for training stability. We validate our approach on the DeepMind Control Suite, ManiSkill3, and a mobile robot environment, modified to include auxiliary behavioral objectives. Our method proves to be simple yet effective, substantially outperforming baselines trained directly on the full reward while exhibiting higher robustness to specific reward weightings.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段奖励课程学习框架，将任务目标与行为目标解耦，先训练简化任务奖励再引入完整奖励，显著提升多目标强化学习性能
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习在机器人控制中面临奖励函数设计困难，实际任务通常需要同时优化多个目标，需要精确调整权重以获得期望策略特性
AI.method: 提出两阶段奖励课程学习：第一阶段使用简化的任务专用奖励函数训练智能体，确保有效探索；第二阶段引入包含能量效率等辅助行为目标的完整奖励函数。分析不同过渡策略，证明阶段间样本重用对训练稳定性至关重要
AI.result: 在DeepMind Control Suite、ManiSkill3和移动机器人环境中验证方法有效性，显著优于直接在完整奖励上训练的基线方法，对特定奖励权重具有更高鲁棒性
AI.conclusion: 该方法简单有效，通过解耦任务目标与行为目标并采用两阶段课程学习，解决了多目标强化学习中奖励函数设计的挑战

title: Distributed Partial Information Puzzles: Examining Common Ground Construction Under Epistemic Asymmetry
summary: Establishing common ground, a shared set of beliefs and mutually recognized facts, is fundamental to collaboration, yet remains a challenge for current AI systems, especially in multimodal, multiparty settings, where the collaborators bring different information to the table. We introduce the Distributed Partial Information Puzzle (DPIP), a collaborative construction task that elicits rich multimodal communication under epistemic asymmetry. We present a multimodal dataset of these interactions, annotated and temporally aligned across speech, gesture, and action modalities to support reasoning over propositional content and belief dynamics. We then evaluate two paradigms for modeling common ground (CG): (1) state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs), prompted to infer shared beliefs from multimodal updates, and (2) an axiomatic pipeline grounded in Dynamic Epistemic Logic (DEL) that incrementally performs the same task. Results on the annotated DPIP data indicate that it poses a challenge to modern LLMs' abilities to track both task progression and belief state.

AI.tldr: 论文提出分布式部分信息谜题(DPIP)作为评估AI系统在多模态多方协作中建立共同基础能力的基准，并比较了LLM与基于动态认知逻辑的演绎方法在该任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统在多模态多方协作环境中建立共同基础（共享信念和相互认可的事实）仍面临挑战，特别是在参与者拥有不同信息的认知不对称情况下。
AI.method: 引入分布式部分信息谜题(DPIP)作为协作构建任务，收集多模态交互数据集（语音、手势、动作），并评估两种建模共同基础的方法：1) 提示LLM从多模态更新推断共享信念；2) 基于动态认知逻辑(DEL)的公理化管道。
AI.result: 在标注的DPIP数据上，结果表明该任务对现代LLM同时追踪任务进展和信念状态的能力构成挑战。
AI.conclusion: DPIP为研究多模态多方协作中的共同基础建立提供了有价值的基准，揭示了当前LLM在该复杂推理任务上的局限性。

title: FedBCD:Communication-Efficient Accelerated Block Coordinate Gradient Descent for Federated Learning
summary:
Although Federated Learning has been widely studied in recent years, there are still high overhead expenses in each communication round for large-scale models such as Vision Transformer. To lower the communication complexity, we propose a novel Federated Block Coordinate Gradient Descent (FedBCGD) method for communication efficiency. The proposed method splits model parameters into several blocks, including a shared block and enables uploading a specific parameter block by each client, which can significantly reduce communication overhead. Moreover, we also develop an accelerated FedBCGD algorithm (called FedBCGD+) with client drift control and stochastic variance reduction. To the best of our knowledge, this paper is the first work on parameter block communication for training large-scale deep models. We also provide the convergence analysis for the proposed algorithms. Our theoretical results show that the communication complexities of our algorithms are a factor $1/N$ lower than those of existing methods, where $N$ is the number of parameter blocks, and they enjoy much faster convergence than their counterparts. Empirical results indicate the superiority of the proposed algorithms compared to state-of-the-art algorithms.
  The code is available at https://github.com/junkangLiu0/FedBCGD.

AI.tldr: 提出FedBCGD和FedBCGD+两种联邦学习算法，通过参数分块上传显著降低大规模模型（如Vision Transformer）的通信开销
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在大规模模型（如Vision Transformer）训练中存在每轮通信开销高的问题，需要降低通信复杂度
AI.method: 将模型参数分为多个块（包括共享块），每个客户端只上传特定参数块；FedBCGD+进一步加入客户端漂移控制和随机方差缩减
AI.result: 理论分析显示通信复杂度比现有方法降低1/N倍（N为参数块数），收敛速度更快；实证结果表明优于现有最先进算法
AI.conclusion: FedBCGD和FedBCGD+是首个针对大规模深度模型的参数块通信方法，能显著降低通信开销并加速收敛

title: Towards Provably Unbiased LLM Judges via Bias-Bounded Evaluation
summary: As AI models progress beyond simple chatbots into more complex workflows, we draw ever closer to the event horizon beyond which AI systems will be utilized in autonomous, self-maintaining feedback loops. Any autonomous AI system will depend on automated, verifiable rewards and feedback; in settings where ground truth is sparse or non-deterministic, one practical source of such rewards is an LLM-as-a-Judge. Although LLM judges continue to improve, the literature has yet to introduce systems capable of enforcing standards with strong guarantees, particularly when bias vectors are unknown or adversarially discovered. To remedy this issue, we propose average bias-boundedness (A-BB), an algorithmic framework which formally guarantees reductions of harm/impact as a result of any measurable bias in an LLM judge. Evaluating on Arena-Hard-Auto with four LLM judges, we achieve (tau=0.5, delta=0.01) bias-bounded guarantees while retaining 61-99% correlation with original rankings across formatting and schematic bias settings, with most judge-bias combinations exceeding 80%. The code to reproduce our findings is available at https://github.com/penfever/bias-bounded-evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出平均偏置有界性(A-BB)框架，为LLM评判系统提供形式化保证，减少可测量偏置带来的危害，在Arena-Hard-Auto基准上实现偏置有界保证的同时保持61-99%的原始排名相关性。
AI.motivation: 随着AI模型从简单聊天机器人发展为复杂工作流，自主AI系统将依赖自动化的可验证奖励和反馈。在缺乏确定基准的场景中，LLM作为评判者成为实用方案，但现有系统缺乏对未知或对抗性偏置的强保证机制。
AI.method: 提出平均偏置有界性(A-BB)算法框架，通过形式化方法保证LLM评判中任何可测量偏置带来的危害/影响得到减少。在Arena-Hard-Auto基准上使用四个LLM评判者进行评估，涵盖格式化和模式化偏置设置。
AI.result: 在(tau=0.5, delta=0.01)参数下实现偏置有界保证，同时保持61-99%的原始排名相关性，大多数评判者-偏置组合超过80%相关性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: A-BB框架为LLM评判系统提供了形式化的偏置控制保证，在保持评判质量的同时减少偏置带来的危害，为自主AI系统的可靠反馈机制提供了重要工具。

title: The Spike, the Sparse and the Sink: Anatomy of Massive Activations and Attention Sinks
summary: We study two recurring phenomena in Transformer language models: massive activations, in which a small number of tokens exhibit extreme outliers in a few channels, and attention sinks, in which certain tokens attract disproportionate attention mass regardless of semantic relevance. Prior work observes that these phenomena frequently co-occur and often involve the same tokens, but their functional roles and causal relationship remain unclear. Through systematic experiments, we show that the co-occurrence is largely an architectural artifact of modern Transformer design, and that the two phenomena serve related but distinct functions. Massive activations operate globally: they induce near-constant hidden representations that persist across layers, effectively functioning as implicit parameters of the model. Attention sinks operate locally: they modulate attention outputs across heads and bias individual heads toward short-range dependencies. We identify the pre-norm configuration as the key choice that enables the co-occurrence, and show that ablating it causes the two phenomena to decouple.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了Transformer语言模型中的两种现象：大规模激活和注意力汇，发现它们的共现是Transformer架构的产物，两者功能相关但不同。
AI.motivation: 研究Transformer语言模型中大规模激活（少数token在少数通道中出现极端异常值）和注意力汇（某些token吸引不成比例的注意力）这两种反复出现的现象，探索它们的功能角色和因果关系。
AI.method: 通过系统实验分析两种现象的共现关系，识别预归一化配置作为关键因素，并通过消融实验验证两者解耦。
AI.result: 大规模激活具有全局功能，产生跨层持续的近似恒定隐藏表示；注意力汇具有局部功能，调节注意力输出并偏向短程依赖。预归一化配置是两者共现的关键，消融该配置会导致两种现象解耦。
AI.conclusion: 大规模激活和注意力汇是Transformer架构中相关但功能不同的现象，它们的共现主要是现代Transformer设计的架构产物，而非功能上的必然联系。

title: Balancing Privacy-Quality-Efficiency in Federated Learning through Round-Based Interleaving of Protection Techniques
summary:
In federated learning (FL), balancing privacy protection, learning quality, and efficiency remains a challenge. Privacy protection mechanisms, such as Differential Privacy (DP), degrade learning quality, or, as in the case of Homomorphic Encryption (HE), incur substantial system overhead. To address this, we propose Alt-FL, a privacy-preserving FL framework that combines DP, HE, and synthetic data via a novel round-based interleaving strategy. Alt-FL introduces three new methods, Privacy Interleaving (PI), Synthetic Interleaving with DP (SI/DP), and Synthetic Interleaving with HE (SI/HE), that enable flexible quality-efficiency trade-offs while providing privacy protection.
  We systematically evaluate Alt-FL against representative reconstruction attacks, including Deep Leakage from Gradients, Inverting Gradients, When the Curious Abandon Honesty, and Robbing the Fed, using a LeNet-5 model on CIFAR-10 and Fashion-MNIST. To enable fair comparison between DP- and HE-based defenses, we introduce a new attacker-centric framework that compares empirical attack success rates across the three proposed interleaving methods. Our results show that, for the studied attacker model and dataset, PI achieves the most balanced trade-offs at high privacy protection levels, while DP-based methods are preferable at intermediate privacy requirements. We also discuss how such results can be the basis for selecting privacy-preserving FL methods under varying privacy and resource constraints.

AI.tldr: Alt-FL：结合差分隐私、同态加密和合成数据的隐私保护联邦学习框架，通过轮次交错策略实现隐私保护、学习质量和效率的平衡
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中隐私保护机制存在挑战：差分隐私会降低学习质量，同态加密带来显著系统开销，需要平衡隐私保护、学习质量和效率
AI.method: 提出Alt-FL框架，结合差分隐私、同态加密和合成数据，采用轮次交错策略，包括三种新方法：隐私交错(PI)、带DP的合成交错(SI/DP)、带HE的合成交错(SI/HE)
AI.result: 系统评估显示：在高隐私保护级别下，PI实现最平衡的权衡；在中等隐私要求下，基于DP的方法更优；提出基于攻击者视角的公平比较框架
AI.conclusion: Alt-FL为不同隐私和资源约束下的隐私保护联邦学习方法选择提供了基础，实现了灵活的质效权衡和隐私保护

title: Incentive Aware AI Regulations: A Credal Characterisation
summary: While high-stakes ML applications demand strict regulations, strategic ML providers often evade them to lower development costs. To address this challenge, we cast AI regulation as a mechanism design problem under uncertainty and introduce regulation mechanisms: a framework that maps empirical evidence from models to a license for some market share. The providers can select from a set of licenses, effectively forcing them to bet on their model's ability to fulfil regulation. We aim at regulation mechanisms that achieve perfect market outcome, i.e. (a) drive non-compliant providers to self-exclude, and (b) ensure participation from compliant providers. We prove that a mechanism has perfect market outcome if and only if the set of non-compliant distributions forms a credal set, i.e., a closed, convex set of probability measures. This result connects mechanism design and imprecise probability by establishing a duality between regulation mechanisms and the set of non-compliant distributions. We also demonstrate these mechanisms in practice via experiments on regulating use of spurious features for prediction and fairness. Our framework provides new insights at the intersection of mechanism design and imprecise probability, offering a foundation for development of enforceable AI regulations.

AI.tldr: 将AI监管建模为不确定性下的机制设计问题，提出监管机制框架，通过许可证映射实证证据到市场份额，迫使提供商对其模型满足监管要求的能力下注。
AI.motivation: 高风险的机器学习应用需要严格监管，但策略性ML提供商经常规避监管以降低开发成本。需要设计可执行的AI监管框架来解决这一挑战。
AI.method: 将AI监管建模为不确定性下的机制设计问题，引入监管机制框架：将模型实证证据映射到市场份额许可证。提供商可以从一组许可证中选择，迫使其对模型满足监管要求的能力下注。研究实现完美市场结果的监管机制。
AI.result: 证明机制具有完美市场结果当且仅当非合规分布集合构成一个credal set（封闭、凸的概率测度集合）。建立了监管机制与非合规分布集合之间的对偶性，连接了机制设计和不精确概率理论。通过实验展示了在监管预测中使用虚假特征和公平性方面的应用。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为机制设计和不精确概率理论的交叉领域提供了新见解，为开发可执行的AI监管奠定了基础。

title: Stable-LoRA: Stabilizing Feature Learning of Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely adopted parameter-efficient method for fine-tuning Large Langauge Models. It updates the weight matrix as $W=W_0+sBA$, where $W_0$ is the original frozen weight, $s$ is a scaling factor and $A$,$B$ are trainable low-rank matrices. Despite its robust empirical effectiveness, the theoretical foundations of LoRA remain insufficiently understood, particularly with respect to feature learning stability. In this paper, we first establish that, LoRA can, in principle, naturally achieve and sustain stable feature learning (i.e., be self-stabilized) under appropriate hyper-parameters and initializations of $A$ and $B$. However, we also uncover a fundamental limitation that the necessary non-zero initialization of $A$ compromises self-stability, leading to suboptimal performances. To address this challenge, we propose Stable-LoRA, a weight-shrinkage optimization strategy that dynamically enhances stability of LoRA feature learning. By progressively shrinking $A$ during the earliest training steps, Stable-LoRA is both theoretically and empirically validated to effectively eliminate instability of LoRA feature learning while preserving the benefits of the non-zero start. Experiments show that Stable-LoRA consistently outperforms other baselines across diverse models and tasks, with no additional memory usage and only negligible computation overheads. The code is available at https://github.com/Yize-Wu/Stable-LoRA.

AI.tldr: 提出Stable-LoRA方法，通过权重收缩策略解决LoRA特征学习不稳定的问题，在保持非零初始化优势的同时提升性能
AI.motivation: 尽管LoRA在经验上表现良好，但其理论基础特别是特征学习稳定性方面理解不足。研究发现LoRA在适当超参数和初始化下可以实现自稳定特征学习，但必要的非零A矩阵初始化会破坏这种自稳定性，导致次优性能。
AI.method: 提出Stable-LoRA方法，采用权重收缩优化策略，在训练早期阶段动态收缩A矩阵，从而消除LoRA特征学习的不稳定性，同时保留非零初始化的优势。
AI.result: 实验表明Stable-LoRA在各种模型和任务上持续优于其他基线方法，且不增加内存使用，计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: Stable-LoRA有效解决了LoRA特征学习的不稳定性问题，在理论和实证上都得到验证，为参数高效微调提供了更稳定的解决方案。

title: Early Warning of Intraoperative Adverse Events via Transformer-Driven Multi-Label Learning
summary: Early warning of intraoperative adverse events plays a vital role in reducing surgical risk and improving patient safety. While deep learning has shown promise in predicting the single adverse event, several key challenges remain: overlooking adverse event dependencies, underutilizing heterogeneous clinical data, and suffering from the class imbalance inherent in medical datasets. To address these issues, we construct the first Multi-label Adverse Events dataset (MuAE) for intraoperative adverse events prediction, covering six critical events. Next, we propose a novel Transformerbased multi-label learning framework (IAENet) that combines an improved Time-Aware Feature-wise Linear Modulation (TAFiLM) module for static covariates and dynamic variables robust fusion and complex temporal dependencies modeling. Furthermore, we introduce a Label-Constrained Reweighting Loss (LCRLoss) with co-occurrence regularization to effectively mitigate intra-event imbalance and enforce structured consistency among frequently co-occurring events. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IAENet consistently outperforms strong baselines on 5, 10, and 15-minute early warning tasks, achieving improvements of +5.05%, +2.82%, and +7.57% on average F1 score. These results highlight the potential of IAENet for supporting intelligent intraoperative decision-making in clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了IAENet框架，用于术中不良事件的多标签早期预警，通过改进的TAFiLM模块融合静态和动态数据，并引入LCRLoss解决类别不平衡问题，在5-15分钟预警任务中显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 术中不良事件的早期预警对降低手术风险和改善患者安全至关重要。现有深度学习方法存在三个主要挑战：忽视不良事件间的依赖关系、未充分利用异构临床数据、以及医疗数据集中固有的类别不平衡问题。
AI.method: 1. 构建首个术中多标签不良事件数据集(MuAE)，涵盖六种关键事件；2. 提出基于Transformer的多标签学习框架IAENet，包含改进的时间感知特征线性调制(TAFiLM)模块，用于静态协变量和动态变量的鲁棒融合及复杂时间依赖建模；3. 引入带共现正则化的标签约束重加权损失(LCRLoss)，有效缓解事件内不平衡并增强频繁共现事件间的结构化一致性。
AI.result: IAENet在5、10和15分钟早期预警任务中持续优于强基线方法，平均F1分数分别提升+5.05%、+2.82%和+7.57%。这些结果突显了IAENet在支持临床实践中智能术中决策的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的IAENet框架通过有效融合异构临床数据、建模事件间依赖关系并解决类别不平衡问题，显著提升了术中多标签不良事件的早期预警性能，为临床智能决策支持提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: SlideSparse: Fast and Flexible (2N-2):2N Structured Sparsity
summary: NVIDIA's 2:4 Sparse Tensor Cores deliver 2x throughput but demand strict 50% pruning -- a ratio that collapses LLM reasoning accuracy (Qwen3: 54% to 15%). Milder $(2N-2):2N$ patterns (e.g., 6:8, 25% pruning) preserve accuracy yet receive no hardware support, falling back to dense execution without any benefit from sparsity. We present SlideSparse, the first system to unlock Sparse Tensor Core acceleration for the $(2N-2):2N$ model family on commodity GPUs. Our Sliding Window Decomposition reconstructs any $(2N-2):2N$ weight block into $N-1$ overlapping 2:4-compliant windows without any accuracy loss; Activation Lifting fuses the corresponding activation rearrangement into per-token quantization at near-zero cost. Integrated into vLLM, SlideSparse is evaluated across various GPUs (A100, H100, B200, RTX 4090, RTX 5080, DGX-spark), precisions (FP4, INT8, FP8, BF16, FP16), and model families (Llama, Qwen, BitNet). On compute-bound workloads, the measured speedup ratio (1.33x) approaches the theoretical upper-bound $N/(N-1)=4/3$ at 6:8 weight sparsity in Qwen2.5-7B, establishing $(2N-2):2N$ as a practical path to accuracy-preserving LLM acceleration. Code available at https://github.com/bcacdwk/vllmbench.

AI.tldr: SlideSparse系统首次在商用GPU上实现了对(2N-2):2N稀疏模式（如6:8）的稀疏张量核心加速，通过滑动窗口分解和激活提升技术，在保持精度的同时获得接近理论上限的速度提升。
AI.motivation: NVIDIA的2:4稀疏张量核心虽然能提供2倍吞吐量，但需要严格的50%剪枝，这会严重损害LLM推理精度（如Qwen3从54%降至15%）。而更温和的(2N-2):2N稀疏模式（如6:8，25%剪枝）能保持精度，但缺乏硬件支持，只能回退到密集执行，无法从稀疏性中获益。
AI.method: SlideSparse采用滑动窗口分解技术，将任意(2N-2):2N权重块重构为N-1个重叠的2:4兼容窗口，实现零精度损失；激活提升技术将相应的激活重排融合到每令牌量化中，成本几乎为零。该系统集成到vLLM中。
AI.result: 在计算受限工作负载下，实测加速比达到1.33倍，接近理论上限N/(N-1)=4/3（对于6:8稀疏度）。在Qwen2.5-7B模型上验证了(2N-2):2N稀疏模式作为保持精度的LLM加速实用路径。
AI.conclusion: SlideSparse首次在商用GPU上解锁了对(2N-2):2N稀疏模式的稀疏张量核心加速，为保持精度的LLM推理加速提供了实用解决方案，代码已开源。

title: A Behaviour-Aware Federated Forecasting Framework for Distributed Stand-Alone Wind Turbines
summary: Accurate short-term wind power forecasting is essential for grid dispatch and market operations, yet centralising turbine data raises privacy, cost, and heterogeneity concerns. We propose a two-stage federated learning framework that first clusters turbines by long-term behavioural statistics using Double Roulette Selection (DRS) initialisation with recursive Auto-split refinement, and then trains cluster-specific LSTM models via FedAvg. Experiments on 400 stand-alone turbines in Denmark show that DRS-auto discovers behaviourally coherent groups and achieves competitive forecasting accuracy while preserving data locality. Behaviour-aware grouping consistently outperforms geographic partitioning and matches strong k-means++ baselines, suggesting a practical privacy-friendly solution for heterogeneous distributed turbine fleets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种两阶段联邦学习框架，通过基于长期行为统计的聚类和集群特定LSTM训练，解决风力涡轮机数据隐私、成本和异质性挑战，实现准确短期风电功率预测。
AI.motivation: 短期风电功率预测对电网调度和市场运营至关重要，但集中化涡轮机数据会引发隐私、成本和异质性担忧。需要一种既能保护数据本地性又能处理设备行为差异的解决方案。
AI.method: 两阶段联邦学习框架：1) 使用双轮盘选择初始化结合递归自动分割优化的方法，基于长期行为统计对涡轮机进行聚类；2) 通过FedAvg算法为每个集群训练特定的LSTM预测模型。
AI.result: 在丹麦400个独立风力涡轮机上的实验表明，DRS-auto方法能发现行为一致的集群，在保持数据本地性的同时达到有竞争力的预测精度。行为感知分组始终优于地理分区，与强基准k-means++性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为异构分布式涡轮机群提供了一种实用的隐私友好解决方案，通过行为感知聚类和联邦学习平衡了预测精度与隐私保护需求。

title: Beyond Word Error Rate: Auditing the Diversity Tax in Speech Recognition through Dataset Cartography
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems are predominantly evaluated using the Word Error Rate (WER). However, raw token-level metrics fail to capture semantic fidelity and routinely obscures the `diversity tax', the disproportionate burden on marginalized and atypical speaker due to systematic recognition failures. In this paper, we explore the limitations of relying solely on lexical counts by systematically evaluating a broader class of non-linear and semantic metrics. To enable rigorous model auditing, we introduce the sample difficulty index (SDI), a novel metric that quantifies how intrinsic demographic and acoustic factors drive model failure. By mapping SDI on data cartography, we demonstrate that metrics EmbER and SemDist expose hidden systemic biases and inter-model disagreements that WER ignores. Finally, our findings are the first steps towards a robust audit framework for prospective safety analysis, empowering developers to audit and mitigate ASR disparities prior to deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了ASR系统中仅依赖词错误率(WER)的局限性，提出了样本难度指数(SDI)来量化人口统计和声学因素对模型失败的影响，并展示了语义指标如何揭示WER忽略的系统性偏见。
AI.motivation: 传统ASR评估主要依赖词错误率(WER)，但该指标无法捕捉语义保真度，且经常掩盖"多样性税"——即边缘化和非典型说话者因系统性识别失败而承受的不成比例的负担。需要更全面的评估框架来揭示隐藏的系统性偏见。
AI.method: 1. 系统评估更广泛的非线性和语义指标；2. 引入样本难度指数(SDI)，量化内在人口统计和声学因素如何驱动模型失败；3. 通过数据制图映射SDI；4. 使用EmbER和SemDist等指标暴露WER忽略的隐藏系统性偏见和模型间分歧。
AI.result: 研究发现EmbER和SemDist等语义指标能够揭示WER忽略的隐藏系统性偏见和模型间分歧。SDI能够有效量化人口统计和声学因素对ASR性能的影响，为模型审计提供了新工具。
AI.conclusion: 该研究是构建稳健审计框架的第一步，使开发者能够在部署前审计和缓解ASR差异。提出的方法为前瞻性安全分析提供了基础，有助于识别和解决ASR系统中的系统性偏见问题。

title: Whispering to a Blackbox: Bootstrapping Frozen OCR with Visual Prompts
summary: In the landscape of modern machine learning, frozen pre-trained models provide stability and efficiency but often underperform on specific tasks due to mismatched data distributions. This paper introduces the Whisperer, a novel visual prompting framework that learns diffusion-based preprocessors to adapt inputs in pixel space, effectively "whispering" enhancements to frozen downstream models like EasyOCR. By framing the process as behavioral cloning of stochastically discovered improvement policies, our method achieves an 8% absolute (10.6% relative) reduction in Character Error Rate (CER) on a challenging dataset of 300k degraded synthetic text images, surpassing hand-engineered baselines such as CLAHE. The key innovation is a four-stage training curriculum that uses behavioral cloning to amplify "lucky" improvements discovered through the stochastic exploration of a partially trained diffusion model. This approach is highly sample-efficient and avoids the pitfalls of traditional reinforcement learning. Crucially, we frame this not as naive reinforcement learning, but as behavioral cloning of an exploration policy: we stochastically sample intermediate diffusion outputs, select those that improve CER by chance, and then train the model to reproduce them. This bootstrapping curriculum (4 stages over 60 GPU-hours) amplifies random successes into a systematic strategy. In summary, by whispering to the frozen OCR through its inputs, we improve an imperfect classifier without touching its weights.

AI.tldr: Whisperer框架通过扩散模型预处理输入图像来增强冻结下游模型性能，使用行为克隆方法学习改进策略，在文本识别任务上显著降低字符错误率
AI.motivation: 冻结预训练模型虽然稳定高效，但在特定任务上因数据分布不匹配而表现不佳，需要一种不修改模型权重就能提升性能的方法
AI.method: 提出Whisperer视觉提示框架：1) 使用扩散模型作为预处理器在像素空间适配输入；2) 通过行为克隆学习随机发现的改进策略；3) 采用四阶段训练课程，从随机成功中系统化学习改进策略
AI.result: 在30万张退化合成文本图像数据集上，相比手工基准方法CLAHE，实现了8%绝对（10.6%相对）的字符错误率降低，仅需60 GPU小时的训练
AI.conclusion: 通过向冻结OCR模型"低语"输入增强，无需修改模型权重即可显著提升不完美分类器的性能，提供了一种高效且稳定的模型适配方法

title: Knowledge Divergence and the Value of Debate for Scalable Oversight
summary: AI safety via debate and reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) are both proposed methods for scalable oversight of advanced AI systems, yet no formal framework relates them or characterizes when debate offers an advantage. We analyze this by parameterizing debate's value through the geometry of knowledge divergence between debating models. Using principal angles between models' representation subspaces, we prove that the debate advantage admits an exact closed form. When models share identical training corpora, debate reduces to RLAIF-like where a single-agent method recovers the same optimum. When models possess divergent knowledge, debate advantage scales with a phase transition from quadratic regime (debate offers negligible benefit) to linear regime (debate is essential). We classify three regimes of knowledge divergence (shared, one-sided, and compositional) and provide existence results showing that debate can achieve outcomes inaccessible to either model alone, alongside a negative result showing that sufficiently strong adversarial incentives cause coordination failure in the compositional regime, with a sharp threshold separating effective from ineffective debate. We offer the first formal connection between debate and RLAIF, a geometric foundation for understanding when adversarial oversight protocols are justified, and connection to the problem of eliciting latent knowledge across models with complementary information.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了辩论与RLAIF之间的首个形式化联系，通过知识分歧的几何参数化证明了辩论优势的闭式解，并识别了三种知识分歧机制及辩论有效性的相变阈值。
AI.motivation: AI安全领域提出了辩论和基于AI反馈的强化学习（RLAIF）两种可扩展监督方法，但缺乏形式化框架来关联这两种方法或刻画辩论何时具有优势。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立辩论与RLAIF之间的形式化联系，并提供理解对抗性监督协议何时合理的几何基础。
AI.method: 通过模型表示子空间之间的主角度参数化知识分歧的几何结构，推导出辩论优势的精确闭式解。分析三种知识分歧机制（共享、单边、组合），证明辩论可实现任一模型单独无法达到的结果。识别辩论有效性的相变阈值，特别是组合机制中对抗性激励导致协调失败的临界点。
AI.result: 1. 当模型共享相同训练语料时，辩论退化为类似RLAIF的单智能体方法，可恢复相同最优解。2. 当模型具有分歧知识时，辩论优势呈现从二次机制（辩论效益可忽略）到线性机制（辩论至关重要）的相变。3. 证明了辩论可实现任一模型单独无法达到的结果，同时发现足够强的对抗性激励会导致组合机制中的协调失败，存在分离有效与无效辩论的尖锐阈值。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了辩论与RLAIF之间的首个形式化联系，提供了理解对抗性监督协议何时合理的几何基础。研究结果表明辩论优势取决于模型间知识分歧的几何结构，识别了三种知识分歧机制及其对应的辩论有效性条件，为在不同知识配置下选择适当的监督方法提供了理论指导。

title: WavSLM: Single-Stream Speech Language Modeling via WavLM Distillation
summary: Large language models show that simple autoregressive training can yield scalable and coherent generation, but extending this paradigm to speech remains challenging due to the entanglement of semantic and acoustic information. Most existing speech language models rely on text supervision, hierarchical token streams, or complex hybrid architectures, departing from the single-stream generative pretraining paradigm that has proven effective in text. In this work, we introduce WavSLM, a speech language model trained by quantizing and distilling self-supervised WavLM representations into a single codebook and optimizing an autoregressive next-chunk prediction objective. WavSLM jointly models semantic and acoustic information within a single token stream without text supervision or text pretraining. Despite its simplicity, it achieves competitive performance on consistency benchmarks and speech generation while using fewer parameters, less training data, and supporting streaming inference. Demo samples are available at https://lucadellalib.github.io/wavslm-web/.

AI.tldr: WavSLM：一种无需文本监督的单流语音语言模型，通过量化WavLM表示并采用自回归下一块预测目标，在单一标记流中联合建模语义和声学信息
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的自回归训练范式在文本领域取得了成功，但扩展到语音领域面临挑战，因为语音中语义和声学信息相互纠缠。现有语音语言模型大多依赖文本监督、分层标记流或复杂混合架构，偏离了在文本领域证明有效的单流生成预训练范式。
AI.method: 将自监督WavLM表示量化和蒸馏到单一码本中，然后优化自回归下一块预测目标。模型在单一标记流中联合建模语义和声学信息，无需文本监督或文本预训练。
AI.result: 在一致性基准测试和语音生成方面取得竞争性性能，同时使用更少的参数、更少的训练数据，并支持流式推理。
AI.conclusion: WavSLM证明了简单自回归训练范式可以扩展到语音领域，在单一标记流中联合建模语义和声学信息，无需文本监督，为语音语言模型提供了一种更简洁有效的架构。

title: GALACTIC: Global and Local Agnostic Counterfactuals for Time-series Clustering
summary: Time-series clustering is a fundamental tool for pattern discovery, yet existing explainability methods, primarily based on feature attribution or metadata, fail to identify the transitions that move an instance across cluster boundaries. While Counterfactual Explanations (CEs) identify the minimal temporal perturbations required to alter the prediction of a model, they have been mostly confined to supervised settings. This paper introduces GALACTIC, the first unified framework to bridge local and global counterfactual explainability for unsupervised time-series clustering. At instance level (local), GALACTIC generates perturbations via a cluster-aware optimization objective that respects the target and underlying cluster assignments. At cluster level (global), to mitigate cognitive load and enhance interpretability, we formulate a representative CE selection problem. We propose a Minimum Description Length (MDL) objective to extract a non-redundant summary of global explanations that characterize the transitions between clusters. We prove that our MDL objective is supermodular, which allows the corresponding MDL reduction to be framed as a monotone submodular set function. This enables an efficient greedy selection algorithm with provable $(1-1/e)$ approximation guarantees. Extensive experimental evaluation on the UCR Archive demonstrates that GALACTIC produces significantly sparser local CEs and more concise global summaries than state-of-the-art baselines adapted for our problem, offering the first unified approach for interpreting clustered time-series through counterfactuals.

AI.tldr: GALACTIC是首个统一的无监督时间序列聚类反事实解释框架，通过局部实例级扰动和全局聚类级代表性选择，提供可解释的聚类边界转换分析。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列聚类的可解释性方法主要基于特征归因或元数据，无法识别实例跨越聚类边界的转换过程。虽然反事实解释能够识别改变模型预测所需的最小时间扰动，但主要局限于监督学习场景。需要一种统一框架来桥接无监督时间序列聚类的局部和全局反事实可解释性。
AI.method: 提出GALACTIC框架：1）局部层面：通过聚类感知优化目标生成扰动，尊重目标和底层聚类分配；2）全局层面：制定代表性反事实选择问题，提出最小描述长度目标提取非冗余的全局解释摘要，表征聚类间转换。证明MDL目标是超模的，可转化为单调子模集函数，从而设计具有(1-1/e)近似保证的高效贪心选择算法。
AI.result: 在UCR Archive上的广泛实验评估表明，GALACTIC相比为问题调整的最先进基线方法，能生成显著更稀疏的局部反事实解释和更简洁的全局摘要，为通过反事实解释聚类时间序列提供了首个统一方法。
AI.conclusion: GALACTIC首次实现了无监督时间序列聚类的统一反事实解释框架，通过局部扰动和全局代表性选择，有效识别聚类边界转换，显著提升了聚类结果的可解释性，为模式发现提供了新的分析工具。

title: FairFinGAN: Fairness-aware Synthetic Financial Data Generation
comment: Accepted to Special Session: Data Science: Foundations and Applications (DSFA), PAKDD 2026
summary: Financial datasets often suffer from bias that can lead to unfair decision-making in automated systems. In this work, we propose FairFinGAN, a WGAN-based framework designed to generate synthetic financial data while mitigating bias with respect to the protected attribute. Our approach incorporates fairness constraints directly into the training process through a classifier, ensuring that the synthetic data is both fair and preserves utility for downstream predictive tasks. We evaluate our proposed model on five real-world financial datasets and compare it with existing GAN-based data generation methods. Experimental results show that our approach achieves superior fairness metrics without significant loss in data utility, demonstrating its potential as a tool for bias-aware data generation in financial applications.

AI.tldr: FairFinGAN：基于WGAN的框架，通过集成公平性约束生成无偏的合成金融数据，在保持数据效用的同时显著提升公平性指标。
AI.motivation: 金融数据集常存在偏见，导致自动化系统做出不公平决策。需要一种能够生成合成金融数据同时减轻受保护属性偏见的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出FairFinGAN框架，基于Wasserstein GAN架构，通过分类器将公平性约束直接集成到训练过程中，确保合成数据既公平又保持下游预测任务的效用。
AI.result: 在五个真实金融数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比现有GAN方法实现了更优的公平性指标，且没有显著损失数据效用。
AI.conclusion: FairFinGAN展示了作为金融应用中偏见感知数据生成工具的潜力，能够在保持数据质量的同时有效减轻偏见。

title: InfoFlow KV: Information-Flow-Aware KV Recomputation for Long Context
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for long-context question answering is bottlenecked by inference-time prefilling over large retrieved contexts. A common strategy is to precompute key-value (KV) caches for individual documents and selectively recompute a small subset of tokens to restore global causal dependencies, but existing methods rely on heuristics or representation discrepancies without modeling whether selected tokens can effectively influence generation. We cast selective KV recomputation as an information flow problem and show that a simple attention-norm signal from the query reliably identifies tokens that are both semantically relevant and structurally positioned to propagate information, when computed under an inference-consistent RoPE geometry. We therefore reconstruct global positional assignments for retrieved chunks and introduce an information-flow-guided chunk reordering strategy. Experiments on LLM and VLM benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains over prior methods under comparable efficiency budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出基于信息流的KV缓存选择性重计算方法，通过注意力范数信号识别关键token，重构检索块位置分配，提升长上下文问答效率
AI.motivation: 长上下文问答中的检索增强生成受限于推理时对大检索上下文的预填充计算瓶颈，现有方法依赖启发式或表示差异，未能建模所选token是否有效影响生成
AI.method: 将选择性KV重计算建模为信息流问题，使用查询的注意力范数信号识别语义相关且结构定位可传播信息的token，在推理一致的RoPE几何下计算，重构检索块的全局位置分配，引入信息流引导的块重排序策略
AI.result: 在LLM和VLM基准测试中，在可比效率预算下相比先前方法获得一致性能提升
AI.conclusion: 注意力范数信号能可靠识别信息流关键token，信息流引导的块重排序策略能有效提升长上下文问答中检索增强生成的效率

title: Embedded Inter-Subject Variability in Adversarial Learning for Inertial Sensor-Based Human Activity Recognition
comment: Accepted in the IEEE 35th International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP). This is the author's version of the work
summary: This paper addresses the problem of Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using data from wearable inertial sensors. An important challenge in HAR is the model's generalization capabilities to new unseen individuals due to inter-subject variability, i.e., the same activity is performed differently by different individuals. To address this problem, we propose a novel deep adversarial framework that integrates the concept of inter-subject variability in the adversarial task, thereby encouraging subject-invariant feature representations and enhancing the classification performance in the HAR problem. Our approach outperforms previous methods in three well-established HAR datasets using a leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation. Further results indicate that our proposed adversarial task effectively reduces inter-subject variability among different users in the feature space, and it outperforms adversarial tasks from previous works when integrated into our framework. Code: https://github.com/FranciscoCalatrava/EmbeddedSubjectVariability.git

AI.tldr: 提出一种新颖的深度对抗框架，通过将主体间变异性整合到对抗任务中，增强人类活动识别的泛化能力
AI.motivation: 解决人类活动识别中由于主体间变异性导致的模型对新个体泛化能力不足的问题。不同个体执行相同活动的方式存在差异，这限制了模型在未见个体上的表现。
AI.method: 提出新颖的深度对抗框架，将主体间变异性概念整合到对抗任务中，鼓励学习主体不变的特征表示。使用留一主体交叉验证进行评估。
AI.result: 在三个成熟的HAR数据集上优于先前方法。对抗任务有效减少了特征空间中不同用户的主体间变异性，且比先前工作中的对抗任务在框架中表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 提出的对抗框架通过整合主体间变异性，成功增强了HAR模型的泛化能力，为处理主体间差异提供了有效解决方案。

title: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Compression
summary:
Reasoning models think out loud, but much of what they say is noise. We introduce OPSDC (On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Compression), a method that teaches models to reason more concisely by
  distilling their own concise behavior back into themselves. The entire approach reduces to one idea: condition the same model on a "be concise" instruction to obtain teacher logits, and minimize per-token
  reverse KL on the student's own rollouts. No ground-truth answers, no token budgets, no difficulty estimators. Just self-distillation. Yet this simplicity belies surprising sophistication: OPSDC automatically
  compresses easy problems aggressively while preserving the deliberation needed for hard ones. On Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B, we achieve 57-59% token reduction on MATH-500 while improving accuracy by 9-16 points
  absolute. On AIME 2024, the 14B model gains 10 points with 41% compression. The secret? Much of what reasoning models produce is not just redundant-it is actively harmful, compounding errors with every
  unnecessary token.

AI.tldr: OPSDC是一种通过自我蒸馏来压缩推理过程的方法，仅需"保持简洁"的指令就能显著减少推理token数量，同时提高模型在数学推理任务上的准确性。
AI.motivation: 推理模型在思考过程中会产生大量噪声和冗余信息，这些不必要的token不仅浪费计算资源，还可能累积错误，对最终答案产生负面影响。
AI.method: OPSDC（On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Compression）方法的核心思想是：让同一模型在"保持简洁"的指令下生成教师logits，然后在学生自己的推理轨迹上最小化每个token的反向KL散度。该方法无需真实答案、token预算或难度估计器，仅通过自我蒸馏实现。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-14B模型上，OPSDC在MATH-500数据集上实现了57-59%的token压缩，同时准确率提升了9-16个百分点。在AIME 2024数据集上，14B模型获得了10个百分点的提升，同时实现了41%的压缩。
AI.conclusion: OPSDC的简单性背后隐藏着精妙的机制：它能自动对简单问题进行激进压缩，同时保留困难问题所需的详细推理过程。研究表明，推理模型产生的许多内容不仅是冗余的，而且是有害的，每个不必要的token都可能累积错误。

title: Latent Wasserstein Adversarial Imitation Learning
summary: Imitation Learning (IL) enables agents to mimic expert behavior by learning from demonstrations. However, traditional IL methods require large amounts of medium-to-high-quality demonstrations as well as actions of expert demonstrations, both of which are often unavailable. To reduce this need, we propose Latent Wasserstein Adversarial Imitation Learning (LWAIL), a novel adversarial imitation learning framework that focuses on state-only distribution matching. It benefits from the Wasserstein distance computed in a dynamics-aware latent space. This dynamics-aware latent space differs from prior work and is obtained via a pre-training stage, where we train the Intention Conditioned Value Function (ICVF) to capture a dynamics-aware structure of the state space using a small set of randomly generated state-only data. We show that this enhances the policy's understanding of state transitions, enabling the learning process to use only one or a few state-only expert episodes to achieve expert-level performance. Through experiments on multiple MuJoCo environments, we demonstrate that our method outperforms prior Wasserstein-based IL methods and prior adversarial IL methods, achieving better results across various tasks.

AI.tldr: LWAIL是一种新颖的对抗模仿学习框架，通过动态感知的潜在空间进行状态分布匹配，仅需少量无动作专家轨迹即可达到专家级性能。
AI.motivation: 传统模仿学习方法需要大量中等至高质量演示以及专家动作数据，但这些数据往往难以获取。需要开发能够在仅有少量状态轨迹的情况下有效学习的模仿学习方法。
AI.method: 提出潜在Wasserstein对抗模仿学习（LWAIL）框架，在动态感知潜在空间中进行状态分布匹配。通过预训练阶段训练意图条件价值函数（ICVF），利用少量随机生成的状态数据捕获状态空间的动态感知结构，增强策略对状态转移的理解。
AI.result: 在多个MuJoCo环境中，LWAIL优于先前的Wasserstein-based IL方法和对抗IL方法，仅需1个或少量无动作专家轨迹即可达到专家级性能。
AI.conclusion: LWAIL通过动态感知潜在空间中的Wasserstein距离进行状态分布匹配，显著减少了对专家演示数据的需求，仅需少量状态轨迹即可实现高效模仿学习。

title: POET-X: Memory-efficient LLM Training by Scaling Orthogonal Transformation
comment: Technical report v1 (14 pages, 7 figures, project page: https://spherelab.ai/poetx/)
summary: Efficient and stable training of large language models (LLMs) remains a core challenge in modern machine learning systems. To address this challenge, Reparameterized Orthogonal Equivalence Training (POET), a spectrum-preserving framework that optimizes each weight matrix through orthogonal equivalence transformation, has been proposed. Although POET provides strong training stability, its original implementation incurs high memory consumption and computational overhead due to intensive matrix multiplications. To overcome these limitations, we introduce POET-X, a scalable and memory-efficient variant that performs orthogonal equivalence transformations with significantly reduced computational cost. POET-X maintains the generalization and stability benefits of POET while achieving substantial improvements in throughput and memory efficiency. In our experiments, POET-X enables the pretraining of billion-parameter LLMs on a single Nvidia H100 GPU, and in contrast, standard optimizers such as AdamW run out of memory under the same settings.

AI.tldr: POET-X是POET框架的改进版本，通过减少计算开销和内存消耗，实现了在单GPU上训练十亿参数大语言模型的高效稳定训练方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型训练面临内存消耗大、计算成本高的问题，原始POET方法虽然提供训练稳定性，但存在内存消耗大和计算开销高的局限性。
AI.method: POET-X通过正交等价变换优化权重矩阵，但采用更高效的计算方法，显著降低了矩阵乘法的计算成本，保持了谱保持特性。
AI.result: POET-X在单块Nvidia H100 GPU上成功预训练了十亿参数的大语言模型，而标准优化器（如AdamW）在相同设置下会出现内存不足问题。
AI.conclusion: POET-X在保持POET的泛化和稳定性优势的同时，显著提高了吞吐量和内存效率，为大规模语言模型训练提供了可行的解决方案。
